text: Testing BoltOdds: your key is on GitHub now (the engine shows BOLTODDS_API_KEY, 2 keys). It still wasn't used because BoltOdds' own switch (Settings > APIs > BoltOdds) is OFF on the phone and the engine mirrors your switches; I've sent the phone a request to turn that switch on (it applies within a minute; the Live tab's BoltOdds socket is a separate switch). Your guess about the phone also holding BoltOdds sockets is a real risk: the plan allows 3 connections, the engine uses 2, and the phone's live betting uses its own, so if BoltOdds shows 'connection refused' we turn the phone's BoltOdds socket off (Live tab > Sockets). I'll read the engine log after the switch lands and tell you if the sockets connect.
